widget.heading: 4-Week Build Plan (Privacy-First)
widget.description: A practical roadmap to ship an MVP that improves completion rates for eGov-related tasks via checklists, progress tracking, and standardized summaries—without handling sensitive data.

steps.name: Scope top 5 workflows + content model
steps.detail: Select the most common eGov KZ tasks for your audience, define required documents/steps per workflow, and design a JSON schema for checklists, prerequisites, and help text.

steps.name: MVP UI: checklist + progress + share link
steps.detail: Implement a mobile-first checklist with progress indicator, step details, and a shareable read-only link (no PII). Add local-only notes per step.

steps.name: Copy-ready request summary + templates
steps.detail: Generate a standardized summary (task, completed steps, missing docs, questions) with one-tap copy. Add templates for support teams to reduce back-and-forth.

steps.name: Reminders + offline-first hardening
steps.detail: Add optional reminders (calendar export or local notifications where supported), cache assets for offline use, and ensure graceful degradation on older mobile browsers.

steps.name: QA, accessibility, and analytics (privacy-safe)
steps.detail: Test on common KZ devices/browsers, add keyboard and screen-reader support, and implement privacy-safe event tracking (no user content, no identifiers).
